 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. As preparations continue for the crucial Concacaf Nations League clash against Jamaica, the national team has welcomed European firepower into camp.
 The new arrivals are Armando González and Armando León. Both González and León flew in directly from Europe with the mission of scoring goals during the international break.
 Their arrival will intensify the battle for a starting spot and the chance to lead Mexico's attack in the absence of Raúl Jiménez.
 Will León get any playing time following his first call-up to El Tri?
